title: Corporate Administrator
company: Radcliffe & Co (Life & Pensions) Ltd - Company - Permanent
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an organised and detail-focused Corporate Administrator to join our corporate department on a full time, office-based basis. You will provide essential administrative support to advisers and the wider team, helping to ensure client files, correspondence and processes run smoothly and accurately.

Key Responsibilities

Client & File Administration
- Prepare, process and maintain client files and records, ensuring accuracy and compliance with company procedures.
- Support advisers with the preparation of client documentation, reports and correspondence.
- Input and update client data across internal systems and databases.
- Ensure documentation is filed, tracked and retrievable in line with regulatory requirements.

Group Schemes Administration
- Provide ongoing administration of group pension schemes, including member updates, contributions and renewals.
- Administer other group risk schemes (e.g. group life, income protection, private medical insurance), liaising with providers as required.
- Keep scheme records accurate and up to date, and respond to member and employer queries relating to group schemes.

Correspondence & Communication
- Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence relating to client and corporate matters.
- Liaise with clients, providers and third parties by phone and email in a professional manner.
- Draft routine letters, emails and administrative communications.

Process & Compliance Support
- Support the corporate department with day-to-day administrative processes and workflows.
- Assist with the preparation of reports, valuations and meeting packs.
- Help ensure processes meet internal compliance and regulatory standards.
- Provide diary management and scheduling support for advisers and meetings.

Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in an administrative role, ideally within financial services or a corporate environment (essential).
- Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Well organised, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
- Confident using Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, Excel) and client database systems.
- Understanding of confidentiality and data protection requirements.
- Experience with financial services processes or terminology is desirable.

Personal Attributes
- Methodical, accurate and detail-oriented.
- Reliable, professional and trustworthy with sensitive information.
- Proactive, with a willingness to take ownership of tasks.
- A strong team player who works well under guidance and independently.

What We Offer
- Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
- Full time, office-based role within a supportive team, one day work from home per week will be offered after successfully completing probation
- Opportunity to develop within the financial services sector.
- Group Pension Scheme
- 20 days holiday (rising to 25 according to length of service)
- Christmas shut-down
- Group Medical Benefits
- Group Life
- Group PHI

Company Culture

At Radcliffe IFA, we're a close-knit team built on trust, integrity and genuinely caring about the people we work with - both our clients and each other. We take pride in our professional, polished environment while keeping things approachable and friendly day to day. We support one another, value initiative, and believe good work deserves recognition. If you're looking for a workplace where your contribution is noticed and your career can grow, you'll feel at home here.

title: HR Assistant
description:
HR Coordinator Location: SouthamptonSalary: £35,000-£37,500, depending on experienceWorking pattern: Full time, Monday to FridayHybrid working: Three days in the office and two days from home We are partnering with a highly regarded, established professional services firm to recruit an experienced HR Coordinator. This is a broad and responsible opportunity within a supportive HR team, offering exposure across HR operations, employee engagement, learning and development, HR systems and the full employee lifecycle. The position is considerably broader than a traditional HR Assistant role and would suit someone with several years of HR experience who is ready to take greater ownership and become a trusted point of contact within the team. The Role You will provide accurate, responsive and commercially focused HR support across the organisation. Responsibilities will include:
- Coordinating new-starter and onboarding processes
- Preparing contracts, letters and employee documentation
- Managing pre-employment checks and induction arrangements
- Tracking probation periods and contractual changes
- Maintaining personnel files and employee records
- Processing salary, promotion and organisational updates
- Supporting payroll-related administration
- Coordinating leaver processes
- Responding to first-line HR queries
- Supporting employee-relations documentation and meetings
- Assisting with benefits, recognition and wellbeing initiatives
- Maintaining HR templates, policies and guidance documents

HR Systems and Reporting A significant element of the role will be taking day-to-day ownership of the organisation's HR information system. You will:
- Maintain accurate employee information
- Process changes to roles, salaries, reporting lines and contracts
- Produce standard and bespoke reports
- Support colleagues with routine system queries
- Help develop reporting functionality
- Review reports for accuracy, omissions and inconsistencies
- Analyse and manipulate HR data using Excel

Experience of a specific HR platform is not essential, as training can be provided. However, strong experience using an HR database or HRIS is required. You must be someone who checks and questions data rather than assuming that a system-generated report is automatically correct. Learning and Development You will also support the administration of professional development and qualification programmes, including:
- Coordinating trainee qualification pathways
- Supporting examination and registration processes
- Tracking training and qualification deadlines
- Liaising with employees, managers and external professional bodies
- Administering learning and career-development activity
- Supporting induction programmes
- Coordinating development conversations

You will also assist with employee engagement, inclusion and wellbeing initiatives. About You We are looking for someone with approximately three to four years' relevant HR experience who can demonstrate:
- Strong HR administration and employee-lifecycle experience
- Experience maintaining confidential employee data
- Confidence using an HRIS or employee database
- Strong Excel and reporting skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Clear and professional written communication
- The ability to prioritise competing deadlines
- Confidence working with multiple stakeholders
- A proactive and curious approach
- The maturity to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team

Experience within professional services, legal, financial services, accountancy, consultancy or another structured corporate environment would be highly beneficial. You will be commercially aware, emotionally intelligent and comfortable joining an organisation that is continuing to develop its systems, culture and ways of working. This opportunity will not suit someone who wants to complete tasks without considering their wider purpose. The organisation is looking for someone who notices inconsistencies, asks sensible questions and looks for opportunities to improve how things are done. Why Apply?
- Broad exposure across multiple areas of HR
- Ownership of a business-critical HR system
- Excellent experience in reporting and employee data
- Involvement in learning and professional qualifications
- A supportive and experienced HR team
- High visibility across the organisation
- Genuine scope to improve processes and ways of working
- A newly refurbished, collaborative office environment

Please apply with your CV for immediate consideration.
